CHAPTER.VERS: O give thanks unto Jehovah, for He is good! For His mercy is eternal.
Let Israel now say, His mercy is eternal.
Let the house of Aaron now say, His mercy is eternal.
Let those who fear Jehovah now say, His mercy is eternal.
I called upon YAH in distress; YAH answered me and set me in a broad place.
Jehovah is on my side; I will not fear. What can man do to me?
Jehovah is for me among those who help me; therefore I shall see my desire upon those who hate me.
It is better to trust in Jehovah than to put confidence in man.
It is better to trust in Jehovah than to put confidence in princes.
All the nations have surrounded me, but in the name of Jehovah I will destroy them.
They have surrounded me, yea, they have surrounded me; but in the name of Jehovah I will destroy them.
They have surrounded me like bees. They have been quenched like a fire of thorns, for in the name of Jehovah I will destroy them.
You have pushed me violently, to make me fall; but Jehovah has helped me.
YAH is my strength and song, and He has become my salvation.
The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous; the right hand of Jehovah works with might.
The right hand of Jehovah is exalted; the right hand of Jehovah works with might.
I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of YAH.
YAH has chastened and corrected me, but He has not given me over to death.
Open unto me the gates of righteousness; I will go through them, and I will praise YAH.
This is the gate of Jehovah, through which the righteous shall enter.
I will praise You, for You have answered me, and have become my salvation.
The stone which the builders have rejected has become the Head of the corner.
This is from Jehovah; it is marvelous in our eyes.
This is the day Jehovah has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
Deliver now, I beseech You, O Jehovah; O Jehovah, I beseech You: Send now prosperity.
Blessed is He who comes in the name of Jehovah! We have blessed you out of the house of Jehovah.
The Mighty God is Jehovah, who shines upon us. Bind the sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
You are my Mighty God, and I will give thanks to You; You are my God, I will exalt You.
Oh, give thanks unto Jehovah, for He is good! For His mercy is eternal.
